subtasks.objective: Harden unscoped invoice read paths so get_split_group, getPosInvoiceItems, and get_order_invoice cannot return POS Invoice or linked order details unless the current user is authorized for the invoice and its branch context.
subtasks.acceptance: All three read paths enforce POS Invoice read permission with frappe.has_permission or an equivalent Frappe permission check before returning invoice data, and also enforce the relevant branch scope where branch context is available. Unauthorized invoice names or table identifiers must raise a permission error or return no sensitive invoice data. Add or update focused backend tests covering allowed access and denied cross-branch or no-permission access for the affected functions.
